capture_limitations.text: The Alloy version was neither observed nor declared, so version-sensitive collector behaviour cannot be attributed from this capture alone.
Alloy forwards no scraped metric metadata, leaving type evidence absent for 1078 metric families.
The capture is retained telemetry read during teardown, not a pre-destroy invocation.
Network-proxy and cluster-DNS targets were undiscovered because the deployed pod labels did not match the collector's default selectors.
947 of 1365 metric families lack metadata, so unknown type is sender evidence rather than an estate property.
